headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.6.1-modder.13
summary: This release fixes the update prompt never showing after startup: the new-version dialog now survives a launcher screen recreation while the release check is still in flight, and an update dialog killed by the system no longer blocks future update checks.

items.text: Fixed the "new version available" dialog not appearing on startup: the update screen now opens from the application context, so it still shows even when the main screen is recreated while the GitHub release check is in flight, and the internal update-flow guard is always released so a system-killed dialog can never silently block later checks.
